text: works! for the prefab buildings. if its not a prefab, does it not move from the heightfield?
resolution: User found the gap: the flat-pad lift only followed terrain for PREFAB buildings (grouped by stampId); pieces placed one-by-one have no stampId so they kept their authored y and ignored painted height. Fixed by grouping loose (non-stamped) pieces into connected components via union-find over bounds-touch (the same adjacency the smart-select uses) and lifting each component as one flat pad — so a hand-built structure rides the terrain exactly like a prefab, and a lone piece sits on the ground beneath it. The pass is O(loose^2) bounds-touch but every caller memoizes the lift (recompute only on pieces/terrain change), which is fine at editor scale. Lives in the one shared GAME_BUILD.placed.liftToTerrain helper, so build pane + F2 + compile all get it. Committed 9e2390da9, bundles clean.
